description: Tall greaves of void-black metal with predatory ridges, smoky shadow plating along the calves.
flavor_text: They give the legs the stance of a stalking nightmare.
visual_notes: Tall void-black greaves, predatory ridges, smoky shadow plating along calves, stalking-nightmare stance

name: Crimson Tide Sabatons
description: Spiked demonic sabatons coding in iron-like hue, etched-blood vein patterns and dripping flame visuals on the plating.
flavor_text: Every step feels like a crash into earth's red core.
visual_notes: Spiked demonic sabatons, iron-like hue, etched blood-vein patterns, dripping flame visuals, earth-cracking impact feel

name: Abyssheart Cuirass
description: A black chestplate built around a glowing crimson core, with rib-line armor and subtle dark embossing.
flavor_text: It looks like a demon heart has been sealed inside the breastplate.
visual_notes: Black chestplate, glowing crimson core, rib-line armor pattern, subtle dark embossing, sealed demon-heart motif

name: Maelstrom Conqueror Cuirass
description: A sleek black chest harness of dark layered material with red luminous seams and curved horn-like shoulder details.
flavor_text: It radiates infinite blood-lust and stoic power.
visual_notes: Sleek black chest harness, dark layered material, red luminous seams, curved horn-like shoulder details, blood-lust aura

name: Voidspine Belt
description: A thick black-metal belt with a spine-like front plate, glowing iron bands, and sharp skeletal accents.
flavor_text: Shadow wisps spill downward from the center buckle.
visual_notes: Thick black-metal belt, spine-like front plate, glowing iron bands, sharp skeletal accents, shadow wisps spilling downward

name: Dreadsigil Waistwrap
description: A layered waistwrap of stealth cloth and honed sigils, glowing focused brand with blood-red symbols.
flavor_text: It curls around the midsection like cursed smoke.
visual_notes: Layered waistwrap of stealth cloth, honed glowing sigils, blood-red symbol brand, cursed-smoke curl around midsection

name: Wraithwing Mantle
description: A demonic mantle with wing-like shadow extensions, torn ridge fabric, and ember-red glow trim.
flavor_text: It billows behind the wearer like a being spirit behind the wearer.
visual_notes: Demonic mantle, wing-like shadow extensions, torn ridge fabric, ember-red glow trim, spirit-billow behind wearer

name: Voidlash Spineguard
description: A backplate fused with a shrouded abyssal cloak, featuring skull ridges and a glowing central spine.
flavor_text: The shape feels regal, cursed, and dark-furrowed.
visual_notes: Backplate fused with shrouded abyssal cloak, skull ridges, glowing central spine, regal cursed dark-furrowed shape

name: Dragonforged Vambraces
description: Layered emerald dragon scales wrap the forearms over dark leather, locked by deep-gold hinges and claw-shaped buckles.
flavor_text: Thin rune lines glow between the plates, giving the bracers a relic-forged temple feel.
visual_notes: Layered emerald dragon scales over dark leather, deep-gold hinges, claw-shaped buckles, thin glowing rune lines between plates

name: Dragonforged Greaves
description: Obsidian greaves are faced with emerald scale panels and trimmed in worn gold, protecting the shins and knees with a stalking predator silhouette.
flavor_text: Etched sigils along the knee guards pulse faintly like the ancient wards awakening.
visual_notes: Obsidian greaves, emerald scale panels, worn gold trim, stalking-predator silhouette, faintly pulsing etched sigils on knee guards

name: Dragonforged Cuirass
description: A fitted obsidian chestplate is layered with dragon-scale plating across the pecs and ribs, reinforced by braced gold bindings.
flavor_text: A circular temple seal glows at the sternum, hinting at forgotten heroic lineage.
visual_notes: Fitted obsidian chestplate, dragon-scale plating across pecs and ribs, braced gold bindings, glowing circular temple seal at sternum

name: Dragonforged Mantle
description: A rugged back mantle combines a short scale cape with reinforced shoulder harness straps, shaped like folded drake wings.
flavor_text: Rune-etched spine plates emit a subtle emerald aura, as if guarding the wearer from unseen threats.
visual_notes: Rugged back mantle, short scale cape, reinforced shoulder-harness straps, folded drake-wing shape, rune-etched spine plates with subtle emerald aura

name: Dragonforged Warbelt
description: A heavy leather warbelt is crowned with a gold-drake-head buckle and hanging brass scale tassels that frame the waist.
flavor_text: Its engraved runes glow through cracks in the metal, making it feel like a sacred relic taken from a temple vault.
visual_notes: Heavy leather warbelt, gold drake-head buckle, hanging brass scale tassels, engraved runes glowing through cracks in the metal

name: Temple Sovereign Bracers
description: Ornate bracers combine emerald inlays, obsidian plates, and gilded rune frames into a perfectly balanced relic design.
flavor_text: Their glow is restrained but regal, like treasure reserved for a forgotten ruler.
visual_notes: Ornate bracers, emerald inlays, obsidian plates, gilded rune frames, balanced relic design, restrained regal glow

name: Temple Sovereign Greaves
description: Sculpted greaves with layered scale panels and gold knee seals carry the symmetry of ceremonial guardian armor.
flavor_text: Fine inscriptions trace down the shins in soft emerald light, hinting at ancient authority.
visual_notes: Sculpted greaves, layered scale panels, gold knee seals, ceremonial guardian symmetry, fine emerald inscriptions tracing down the shins

name: Temple Sovereign Aegis
description: A commanding cuirass merges obsidian body armor with deep-gold relief work and dragon-scale chest patterning.
flavor_text: The central rune disk burns with a calm emerald radiance, giving the piece a kingly presence.
visual_notes: Commanding cuirass, obsidian body armor, deep-gold relief work, dragon-scale chest patterning, central rune disk with calm emerald radiance

name: Temple Sovereign Drape
description: A regal back drape pairs a structured shoulder mantle with layered feather-scale panels and relic straps, glowing temple script runs down the spine channel.
flavor_text: It feels like preserving the oath of an ancient order.
visual_notes: Regal back drape, structured shoulder mantle, layered feather-scale panels, relic straps, glowing temple script down the spine channel

name: Temple Sovereign Girdle
description: This artifact girdle features a broad engraved waistband, hanging plated tassels, and a jewel-like emerald clasp at the center.
flavor_text: Its subdued aura makes it feel less like equipment and more like a ceremonial heirloom.
visual_notes: Artifact girdle, broad engraved waistband, hanging plated tassels, jewel-like emerald clasp at center, subdued ceremonial-heirloom aura

name: Plates of the First Lift
description: Crude hammered-steel forearm plates with mismatched rivets and raw leather backing.
flavor_text: Steel forged by a man who'd never lifted a stone before. Crude. Heavy. The cracks tell you he learned. So will you.
visual_notes: Crude hammered-steel forearm plates with mismatched rivets and raw leather backing.

name: Grip-Worn Vambraces
description: Leather-wrapped iron vambraces, palms scuffed smooth from the bar.
flavor_text: The leather remembers every bar you dropped. It does not judge. It only waits for you to hold on longer.
visual_notes: Leather-wrapped iron vambraces, palms scuffed smooth from the bar.

name: Hauler's Yoke
description: A broad iron-banded shoulder yoke built for carrying loads, not for show.
flavor_text: Carry enough and the spine forgets how to bend. Good. Bending was never the point.
visual_notes: A broad iron-banded shoulder yoke built for carrying loads, not for show.

name: Ironset Pauldrons
description: Heavy layered steel pauldrons, soot-stained, riveted to a leather harness.
flavor_text: Shoulders built under load, not in mirrors. They sit heavy because they earned the weight.
visual_notes: Heavy layered steel pauldrons, soot-stained, riveted to a leather harness.

name: Ribcage of the Unbroken
description: A breastplate split once down the centre and hammered shut along a raised seam.
flavor_text: Cracked once, down the middle. Hammered shut. The seam is stronger than the steel around it.
visual_notes: A breastplate split once down the centre and hammered shut along a raised seam.

name: Toilworn Breastplate
description: Dented plate armour, each mark left unrepaired, worn like a record.
flavor_text: Every dent is a day you didn't quit. Wear them like a ledger.
visual_notes: Dented plate armour, each mark left unrepaired, worn like a record.

name: Girdle of the Slow Climb
description: A simple notched iron-and-leather waist girdle, cinched tight.
flavor_text: Tightened one notch at a time, the way a body is built. There is no other way.
visual_notes: A simple notched iron-and-leather waist girdle, cinched tight.

name: Anvil-Bound Waistguard
description: A thick bracing waistguard of banded iron, made to hold under the lift.
flavor_text: Braced against the lift, not the fall. The fall comes for everyone. The lift, you choose.
visual_notes: A thick bracing waistguard of banded iron, made to hold under the lift.

name: Foundling Greaves
description: Plain riveted shin greaves, a beginner's first real leg armour.
flavor_text: Your first real armour for the parts that carry you. They will ache. They will hold.
visual_notes: Plain riveted shin greaves, a beginner's first real leg armour.

name: Quarryman's Tassets
description: Scrap-cut iron tassets lashed over heavy work trousers.
flavor_text: Cut from scrap by hands that knew labour. Honest plate for honest pain.
visual_notes: Scrap-cut iron tassets lashed over heavy work trousers.

name: Treadworn Sabatons
description: Iron-shod sabatons, soles flattened from miles of standing and lifting.
flavor_text: Iron over the feet that never stopped showing up. The ground knows your name now.
visual_notes: Iron-shod sabatons, soles flattened from miles of standing and lifting.
